name: model-scorecard
description: Rate subagent models vs. expectation per task; per-(model x tier) scores + comparison. Free-form hierarchical family-first model names, effort-weighted + stacked + age-decayed views, dimension tags + token-efficiency (Δ/ktok) + derived ranking badges, model-age from knowledge cutoffs, customizable effort config, global append-only data in ~/.claude/scorecard/. Portable pure-Node core usable from any platform.
